reasons: Fuel surcharge percentage (30.5%) exceeds the contract rate derived from DOE diesel price ($3.702) which maps to 26.0% per the fuel table.
Resulting fuel surcharge amount ($80.07) is $11.81 higher than the contract‑allowed amount ($68.26).
Total invoice ($342.61) is more than 1% above the contract‑supported total ($330.80).
decision.dispute_summary: Fuel surcharge applied at 30.5% instead of the contract‑specified 26.0% for the pickup week, resulting in an overcharge.
